name: Transition Plan
one_liner: How the old state hands over to the new one, and when — the mechanics of go-live.
purpose: The Transition Plan defines the goals, prerequisites, activities and responsibilities associated with transitioning from the old (pre-project) to the new (post-project) state. It seeks to minimise disruption to the business during the transition period and to make the roll-out of project outputs smooth and timely. A successful transition is a prerequisite for achieving the planned benefits; all transition activities become part of the Project Work Plan.

fields.what: States the plan's four objectives: document transition goals, ensure a smooth move from project mode to operations mode, identify roll-out prerequisites, prepare the transfer of responsibility.
fields.castor: Move ESM from 14-year-old LOS to the new lending platform without interrupting disbursements.

fields.what: Identify the specific transition goals for this project.
fields.who: PM drafts · PO and BM consulted
fields.castor: Zero missed value dates during cutover; LOS decommissioned; disbursement cycle at 1 working day (SC1).

fields.what: Document what must be completed before transition can start, and define what must be achieved to consider the transition successfully completed.
fields.who: PM drafts · SP and BM consulted
fields.castor: Release 2 accepted (17 Dec 2027); parallel run clean for four weeks; 40 loan administrators trained.

fields.what: Determine the transition timeline and milestones, estimate the length of the transition period and its overlap with other project development activities; develop a high-level schedule.
fields.castor: Parallel run 08 Jan – 30 Apr 2028; cutover 15 May 2028; LOS read-only from 16 May 2028.

fields.f: 2.4. Activities — Activities Description · Estimated Effort · Start-End Dates · Resource · Other Comments
fields.what: Identify all transition activities; repeat tasks for each deliverable or release. Activities can be broken down further and scheduled in the Project Work Plan and controlled as project activities.
fields.castor: Final data conversion from LOS, 12 PD, 11–14 May 2028, Nikola Tesla (solution architect).

fields.what: Identify the roles and responsibilities of all resources involved in every aspect of the transition process.
fields.castor: PM runs cutover; Leonardo da Vinci (SP) hands over; Florence Nightingale (PO) provisionally accepts.

fields.what: Determine any coordination needs between teams or projects.
fields.who: PM drafts · BM and SP consulted
fields.castor: Cutover weekend must avoid EFSF bond rollovers and month-end reconciliation in Finance & Control.

fields.what: Ensure a formal announcement of the transition to production; identify transition communication goals and coordinate them with the Business Implementation Plan; consolidate items in the Communications Management Plan.
fields.who: PM drafts · BM aligns with BIP
fields.castor: Go-live announcement issued by the PO to all ESM staff on 12 May 2028; freeze notice on 08 May.

fields.what: Determine any data backups needed prior to starting or completing the transition.
fields.castor: Full LOS backup and restore test on 13 May 2028, retained for the seven-year audit period.

fields.what: Availability and access rights for the environments in which the project outputs will be released.
fields.castor: Production access rights re-issued by Alan Turing (LISO); contractor accounts removed at cutover.

fields.what: Refer to the Deliverables Acceptance Plan — the acceptance evidence that clears the deliverable for transition.
fields.castor: Cutover conditional on the reconciliation report clearing its two provisionally accepted breaks.

fields.what: Define what needs to be prepared in the environment, including the necessary testing before transition.
fields.castor: Dress-rehearsal cutover on the 22 Apr 2028 weekend, replaying one full disbursement day.

fields.what: Analyse any system and data conversion impact.
fields.who: PM drafts · PCT executes · BIG validates
fields.castor: All live loan agreements and repayment schedules converted from LOS; BIG validates, PO approves.

fields.what: Determine any training to be performed for the transition — here as a cutover prerequisite; the design and delivery of business training belongs to the Business Implementation Plan.
fields.who: PM verifies completion · BM owns delivery
fields.castor: Cutover gated on all 40 loan administrators having completed BIP-delivered training by 30 Apr 2028.

fields.what: Ensure that maintenance and operational support are foreseen from the moment of transition.
fields.who: PM drafts · SP supplies · PO receives
fields.castor: IT & Digital Division assumes level-2 support from 15 May 2028; Levallois SLA runs 90 further days.

fields.what: Define the transfer of responsibility for the project deliverables from the Project Core Team (PCT) to the Project Owner (PO) and support staff.
fields.who: PM schedules · SP hands over · PO accepts
fields.castor: Ownership of the platform passes from the PCT to Lending Operations and IT & Digital on 15 May 2028.

fields.what: Ensure a rollback scenario exists if the transition fails for any reason, so business continuity can be guaranteed.
fields.who: PM drafts · SP prepares · PO decides
fields.castor: LOS kept warm until 30 Jun 2028; PO may order rollback before the 06:00 value-date cut-off.

fields.what: Define or tailor a transition checklist for the project, based on the goals, prerequisites and deliverables of the transition activities; PM²'s template may be customised.
fields.castor: PM² Transition Checklist tailored with the IT Specific tab enabled; link in the CASTOR project folder.

fields.what: Reference any relevant or additional documents by title, version, date and source or location.

traps: Transition Plan moves the system; Business Implementation Plan moves the organisation.
Training sits in both: the BIP designs and delivers it, the Transition Plan only gates cutover on it.
PSC is Accountable, not the PO — even though p.25 lists the PO among its approvers.
The plan does not schedule work: transition activities are scheduled in the Project Work Plan.
Transition Plan is an input to the Business Implementation Plan and vice versa — they are mutual inputs.
